name: s3Download
syntax: s3Download(bucketName, objectName [, target, charset, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, host, timeout])
description: Downloads an object from an S3 bucket. It can save the object to a file, pass it to a function in parts, or return its content.

params.name: target
params.description: Where the data goes: a file object from `fileOpen(path, "write")`, or a function that receives the data in parts. The function's argument name sets how the data is split: `line`, `string{size}` or `binary{size}`. Return false from it to stop. When omitted, the content is returned.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: The S3 access key ID. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.accesskeyid` system property or environment variable.

params.name: secretAccessKey
params.description: The S3 secret access key. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.secretaccesskey` system property or environment variable.

params.name: host
params.description: The hostname of an S3-compatible provider, without `https://`. Defaults to Amazon AWS.

rustcfml.notes: Names the first two arguments `bucket` and `object`, and the secret key argument `secretKey`. `target` is a file path, and the function returns true when it saves to a file. Doesn't list `timeout`.

examples.title: Download an object to a local file
examples.description: Writes the object to the file.

examples.title: Download an object into a string
examples.description: Without a target, the content is returned.
